paras: Upgrade your Subaru WRX STI, BRZ, Mitsubishi Evo, Toyota 86, or Nissan GT-R's rear braking performance with Dixcel brake pads, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel pads are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake pad compounds shown for vehicles equipped with Brembo 2-piston rear calipers, including the Subaru WRX STI (VAB/GVB/GRB), BRZ (ZC6/ZD8), Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution (V-IX), Toyota 86 (ZN6/ZN8), and Nissan GT-R (R35) platforms. Multiple compound options are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the comparison chart on this product page to select the compound best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
